title: Develop a factory admission-review backlog metric for 84 open-source candidates
description: Improve CODEN AI Factory's Adopt-First source admission review process. Given value, a list of synthetic source review flag strings, return one integer counting entries exactly equal to 'license_pending' or 'security_pending'. Count duplicate flags separately. Ignore 'approved', 'source_pinned', 'runtime_disabled', 'security_passed', empty strings and every other label. Start with count = 0, use a simple for flag in value loop, use TWO INDEPENDENT if statements, one with flag == 'license_pending', another with flag == 'security_pending', increment count for each exact match and then return count. Do not use boolean 'or'/'and', combined comparisons, comprehensions, membership comparisons, imports, helper functions, network, files or other services. Generate original Python source as only def transform(value):; do not return or hardcode the values of the examples. This only measures review backlog, it cannot admit or enable software.
